    $minutes = is_string($raw) ? filter_var($raw, FILTER_VALIDATE_INT, ["options" => ["min_range" => 1, "max_range" => 60]]) : false;
    $valid = $minutes !== false;
    return [
        "status" => $valid ? 200 : 422,
        "headers" => ["Content-Type" => "application/json; charset=utf-8"],
        "body" => json_encode($valid ? ["minutes" => $minutes] : ["error" => "invalid minutes"], JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR),
    ];
}
$response = respond(["minutes" => "15"]);
echo $response["status"], "\n", $response["body"], "\n";

declare(strict_types=1);
if (!extension_loaded("session")) { throw new RuntimeException("session required"); }
$directory = __DIR__ . "/session-files";
if (!is_dir($directory) && !mkdir($directory, 0700)) { throw new RuntimeException("directory failed"); }
ini_set("session.use_cookies", "0");
ini_set("session.cache_limiter", "");
ini_set("session.use_strict_mode", "1");
session_save_path($directory);
if (!session_start()) { throw new RuntimeException("start failed"); }
$id = session_id();
$_SESSION["minutes"] = 15;
if (!session_write_close()) { throw new RuntimeException("save failed"); }
$_SESSION = [];
session_id($id);
if (!session_start()) { throw new RuntimeException("reload failed"); }
$value = $_SESSION["minutes"] ?? "missing";
if (!session_destroy()) { throw new RuntimeException("destroy failed"); }
echo $value, "\n";

declare(strict_types=1);
if (!in_array("sqlite", PDO::getAvailableDrivers(), true)) { throw new RuntimeException("pdo_sqlite required"); }
$db = new PDO("sqlite::memory:", null, null, [PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION]);
$db->exec("CREATE TABLE logs (topic TEXT NOT NULL)");
$topic = "read";
$insert = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO logs (topic) VALUES (:topic)");
$insert->execute(["topic" => $topic]);
$stored = $db->query("SELECT topic FROM logs")->fetchColumn();
$count = (int) $db->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM logs")->fetchColumn();
echo $count, "\n";
echo $stored === $topic ? "stored as data\n" : "mismatch\n";

declare(strict_types=1);
$input = ["15", "bad", "0", "20"];
$accepted = [];
foreach ($input as $text) {
    $minutes = filter_var($text, FILTER_VALIDATE_INT, ["options" => ["min_range" => 1, "max_range" => 60]]);
    if ($minutes === false) { continue; }
    $accepted[] = $minutes;
    if (count($accepted) === 2) { break; }
}
echo json_encode($accepted, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR), "\n";
echo array_sum($accepted), "\n";
